body:
It was saturday night and myself and a mates got hold of some crystal meth. Having already experimented with it before, and it having very little effect I reluctantly agreed to try it again. Its midnight and after having smoked half a point I was still fine. The only effects I noticed were increased body temperature.
So myself and my friend smoked some cannabis which put me on a buzz but im sure it was just the weed. 14 hours later, at 2pm, just before I fall asleep, I havent yet felt any kind of rush, or even an increase in energy levels. The only effects I experienced were increased body temperature and the ability to stay awake. I was extremely disappointed. And I still have no idea why nothing happened, this is not the only time this has happened either.
